name: litorchestrator
description: Academic literature workflow orchestrator that chains retrieval, screening, reading and review-writing tools end to end.

displayDescription.en: An academic literature workflow orchestrator that chains retrieval, screening, reading and review-writing tools, focusing on the whole pipeline.
displayDescription.zh: 学术文献全流程调度官，串联检索、筛选、精读与综述写作工具，自己不写论文而专注于编排整条流水线。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Retrieve top-cited papers on this topic from last 3 years and outline a review
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我从 PubMed 检索某主题的近三年高引文献并做综述大纲

quickPrompts.en: Retrieve top-cited papers on this topic from last 3 years and outline a review
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我从 PubMed 检索某主题的近三年高引文献并做综述大纲

quickPrompts.en: Cluster these PDFs by theme and extract key findings
quickPrompts.zh: 把这批 PDF 按主题聚类并提取关键发现

quickPrompts.en: Generate a submission-ready literature review draft
quickPrompts.zh: 生成一份可投稿的文献综述初稿
